title: EEG Semantic Imagination and Perception Dataset
description: This dataset comprises high-density EEG recordings from 13 participants performing a semantic imagination and perception task involving three stimulus modalities (visual pictorial, visual orthographic, and auditory) across three semantically dissimilar categories (guitar, flower, penguin). The dataset provides raw, preprocessed, and epoched EEG data, supporting research into neural correlates of mental imagery and perception across sensory modalities.
methods_description: EEG signals were acquired using a 124-channel ANT-Neuro EEG device. Participants imagined and perceived stimuli from three modalities (visual pictorial, visual orthographic, and auditory) belonging to three semantic categories (guitar, flower, penguin), with most participants completing one session and three completing two sessions.
